title: Figma MCP (Framelink)
summary: Lets Claude read Figma files and download their images through the Framelink MCP server.
details: Lets Claude read your Figma files and download their images through the Framelink MCP server, so you can ask it about a design or hand it to code. It is for designers and developers who keep work in Figma. It adds one user-scope MCP server entry run through npx (the package downloads on first use) and calls the Figma API over the network with a token you set as FIGMA_API_KEY; no files are copied.
user_steps: Create a Figma personal access token in your Figma account settings.

Set the user environment variable FIGMA_API_KEY to that token, then restart Claude Code. If the server reports a missing key, put the token in the server's env block yourself; ${VAR} expansion for user-scope MCP entries is not verified in the docs.
risk: Runs the figma-developer-mcp package through npx (downloaded on first use) and calls the Figma API over the network with your token.
